create_pipeline_pag_sd_inpaint: create a StableDiffusionPAGInpaintPipeline for text-guided image inpainting with perturbed attention guidance
run_pipeline_inpainting: run the pipeline to generate inpainted images from a prompt, source image, and mask using perturbed attention guidance
encode_prompt_text_encoder: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using the CLIP text encoder with optional LoRA scaling and clip skip
prepare_mask_latents_inpainting: prepare mask and masked image latents for inpainting by resizing, encoding, and duplicating for classifier-free guidance
apply_perturbed_attention_guidance: apply perturbed attention guidance to noise predictions to improve image quality during the diffusion denoising loop
